renderer_backend.name: Renderer backend
renderer_backend.description:
<cg>Auto</c>: Vulkan (Windows, Android) or Metal (macOS, iOS), falling back to OpenGL if they can't be used.
<cy>Vulkan / Metal</c>: only use Vulkan / Metal.
<cy>OpenGL</c>: render directly inside Geometry Dash's own OpenGL context.

Takes effect when entering a level.

culling_mode.name: Culling mode
culling_mode.description:
Where on-screen objects are found and transformed every frame.
<cg>Auto</c>: GPU culling when compute shaders and indirect draws are supported; otherwise CPU culling.

Takes effect when entering a level.

show_debug_overlay.name: Show debug overlay
show_debug_overlay.description: Shows renderer information in levels (same as pressing F3). Useful on devices without a keyboard.

overdraw_view.name: Overdraw view
overdraw_view.description: Shows a heat map of how many times Bismuth draws each pixel (same as pressing F4).

ingame_enable.name: Enable debug tools
ingame_enable.description:
Allows you to enable and disable Bismuth while playing by pressing F8. It also allows you to use Difference Mode by pressing F9 (Difference Mode is very unstable).

 WARNING: This option effectively removes any optimization.

unlock_fps.name: Unlock FPS
unlock_fps.description:
Lets Geometry Dash run above your screen's refresh rate by turning off vsync and GD's frame limiter.
Most screens still show one frame per refresh (the newest one), which lowers input latency. Some Android devices don't allow turning vsync off (see the logs).

Uses more power and makes the device hotter.

fps_cap.name: FPS cap
fps_cap.description: Frame rate limit when <cy>Unlock FPS</c> is on. 0 = no limit.
